meta_description: Synergy Auto Care serving Wilson - auto repair that shows up when you call.
h1_emph: Auto repair in Wilson, and straight answers.
hero_lede: Auto repair in Wilson. Call and we will take a look.
card_about: Who you are calling, and the work we do in Wilson.
quote_h2: Tell us what the car is doing
about_p2: 83 customers have left us a review, averaging 4.9 out of 5. We work out of Wilson and the towns around it.
svc_hero_h1: The auto repair work we take on

services.title: Auto repair
services.body: Vehicles are diagnosed and repaired at the actual fault before anything gets replaced.

reviews.author: Felicia Negrete
reviews.text: After moving to a new town I’m thankful to find a clean and reliable auto care company to take my vehicle to have the oil changed. Synergy Auto Care has friendly employees, a clean environment, and always goes over the top for their customers. Today they vacuumed the drivers and passengers side of my vehicle. Thank you Synergy Auto Care!

reviews.author: Danielle Tagliaferri
reviews.text: My first time here and it was amazing! I'm new to NC and to Synergy. I came here in a recommendation and was NOT disappointed. Quick service, friendly people, and clear expectations. They really involve you in the details of your car. 10/10 would recommend and return. Thanks!

reviews.author: Lynwood Williams
reviews.text: Second time that I have been here. Family owned small business. Friendly, professional and knowledgeable.

reviews.author: Randall Moore
reviews.text: I was in and out for a vehicle inspection in less than 7 minutes. Shop is super clean and organized. Every single staff member I encountered greeted me and was nice.

reviews.author: Aja Stone
reviews.text: Super disappointed. I called because I have heard great reviews from others word of mouth about their honesty. I spoke with Nate on the phone and was told he could not give me an estimated quote on the phone. This is the ONLY shop I have dealt with that won’t give me an estimated price on parts and labor with providing make, model and trim. His reasoning was because he doesn’t know the trim what kind of stuff I need and if there is rust or not. I felt uneasy about the above information and wanted to give my honest opinion however I did jump to this review so let me correct that as he was very polite and professional. I just didn’t understand not getting any vehicle information to give a very ROUGH starting point. I live an hour away so driving in to have it looked at with young kids isn’t an easy thing to do. I appreciate the professional response below. Was going to reconsider them in the future when we actually relocate or can make the drive before then to do as requested and get it viewed but need them done soon to not cause damage to my car. Hopefully they can reconsider as well. Only reason for four stars is there was no actual work or experience with conducting business transaction regarding my vehicle to rate further.

reviews.author: Beth Kinzie
reviews.text: i cannot say enough good things about this place!! i was referred by a friend for a new tire and i am SO thankful for that recommendation. their customer service is top-notch! from the second you pull in the parking lot, someone is outside to greet you. the atmosphere inside is clean and fresh - not anything like other auto shops ive been to. rachel and nate are the two names i remember, and they were amazing, but quite literally everyone i encountered was beyond kind and professional. i will definitely be going back! thank you guys so much for your speedy service and getting me back on the road safely! :)

reviews.author: Benjamin Stewart
reviews.text: I could not have been more welcomed by the family team providing service. All communication and processes were spot on. Within a moment I was encouraged that I had selected the finest place for automotive service. All members of team engaged flawlessly. I felt immediately that I was an important part of the family team. Best ever service! Thank you for this moment to share my experience.

reviews.author: Tyler Perry
reviews.text: My wife and I have been coming to Synergy for three years and we don’t have anything but great things to say about them. Josh is very personable and knows who I am by name and what I need every time we come for any service. He is very knowledgeable about what he does and is always completely honest with what needs to be done at a fair price. Overall, I couldn’t recommend anyone better. Great company, great employees, great service.

reviews.author: Sir Black
reviews.text: Can’t express to you the level of professionalism, kindness, and speed this place operates at. I moved from Florida not to long ago and this pace blew every other competitor out of the water. Also, when I had issues past their scope of work they suggested me to another place that does full body. 10/10 at both places. At the other place they fixed a broken seal for my oil leak and replaced my coolant reservoir. I forget the name of the other place but still 10/10

reviews.author: John Bollten
reviews.text: I have gone to Synergy twice in two days. First was for a tire plug to repair a leak caused by a screw in the tire. They jumped right on it, repaired it and placed the tire back on my car. Maybe 15 minutes from start to finish and very reasonable price. Today I took my truck for inspection. They got to it after finishing a car before me. In and out in about 20 minutes. No troubles and allowed me to renew my registration online shortly after. The staff that I have dealt with are beyond friendly and cooperative. I do most of my own car maintenance, but when I need someone, they are my go to! I am glad that they are a family business, so there are no employee managers who will change when the next best job opportunity comes up. I trust them, and that means a lot.

reviews.author: Lara Mi
reviews.text: This place is the best because the staff are courteous, kind and professional. They greeted me as soon as I pulled in and wasted no time at all to see my vehicle was attended to. The waiting room is clean and comfortable, not that I spent much time there because these guys and gals are so quick! Will definitely be back.

reviews.author: E'Lise Barbour
reviews.text: I went to three other places. First. Nobody could handle just a simple oil change on my car. And everybody else was more expensive. These people were great. So nice!! Fair price!! And really fast!! These people are my hero!!

reviews.author: Rebekah Hutchens
reviews.text: Wonderful staff! They’ve always been very kind, respectful & friendly. I’m usually uncomfortable at automotive shops but I do feel very taken care of here and *not* taken advantage of. Great prices & usually in and out within a reasonable timeframe.10/10 would recommend!

reviews.author: Leonic Declet
reviews.text: NOT RECOMMEND THIS HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE. I had replaced my brakes in this horrible customer service. I had some problems with the brakes, went to check my car, they refused to check my breaks. I almost got an accident my car didn't stop in the proper way. Went to this horrible shop, telling my problem and the owner very aggressive attitude and body language of telling me as an ignorant person and the refused to even take a look at my car. I went to White Tire and the check my car for free and they found a caliper was bad installed. NOT RECOMMEND THIS HORRIBLE CUSTOMER SERVICE.

reviews.author: Tad Harrell
reviews.text: If you think all 'quick-oil-change' places are the same, then you haven't been to Synergy. They treat you like you're the only customer they have at that moment. Very professional, very courteous, very quick, and very honest! I go there for routine maintenance, brakes, tires, and other things. Give them a shot if you haven't yet. Josh has a top-shelf crew at Synergy!

reviews.author: Toni Barnes
reviews.text: I got my car inspected and my husband had his truck tires rotated. The place is very clean, the staff is very friendly, they have phone chargers for customer convenience in the waiting area and the prices are better than White's Tire! I will definitely be taking all our vehicles here for oil changes etc. Great location and quick & quality service. My husband raved how much he was pleased with the service he received. Good wishes to the owners!

reviews.author: Jose Chicas
reviews.text: I have been going to him for years for a oil change. They are quick and charge a reasonable price. They also do minor repairs, he fix some coils in my truck and identify the problem quick. Another Shop charge me $500.00 and didn't fix my problem. I would highly recommend.

reviews.author: Lenore DeLitizia
reviews.text: Went to this facility this morning under my son's recommendation for my auto inspection. He was right. The service is A+. I was in and out withing 10 minutes. The staff is very friendly and professional. I will definitely go there for my oil change and tire rotation.

reviews.author: Blake Eatmon
reviews.text: I won’t ever take my vehicles anywhere else for service or inspections. Josh and his wife run a top notch operation and the service can’t be beat.

reviews.author: Steven P. French ESQ
reviews.text: This place is awesome! Had my truck inspected this morning, I might have been there 15 minutes. I noticed they had some beard shirts on a shelf, had to buy one. Pretty cool shirt, I’ll advertise for sure.

reviews.author: Blake/Peggy Cale
reviews.text: I would give this place TEN STARS. I ALWAYS get great service that is prompt and efficient.They do it right the first time. I have been coming to Synergy since almost the first week of their opening. Josh has a well trained and positive staff there every day. I tell all my family and friends about the OLD FASHIONED service there. Have 5 vehicles that they service for me.

reviews.author: James A
reviews.text: Can’t say enough good things about this business! Friendly, efficient, prompt, affordable! Great customer service!

reviews.author: Natasha Holt
reviews.text: The team here was wonderful helping in us with a tire issue on our horse trailer while we were on an out-of-town roadtrip. They were quick and efficient in helping us before our tire blew out on the road, which would have left us stranded on a hot, summer day with a baby horse in the trailer. Thank you, Synergy team!

reviews.author: Kyle Stevenson
reviews.text: This place is great! I was greeted as soon as I rode up to do a safety inspection and it was taken care of quick and easy! Highly recommend if you need a safety inspection. Seriously upper level customer service.

reviews.author: A Reynolds
reviews.text: I needed to replace lug nuts that had expanded due heat expansion, the dealership price was high. I had Synergy Auto and not only were they cheaper and the replacement was quality standard was higher than offered by the dealership, they were able to get me in & out. They are professional, courteous and friendly. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND!! You will not be disappointed.

reviews.author: KS W
reviews.text: I called and asked if someone would be able to look at the front end of my car for why the tires were wearing out in such a short amount of time and whether I needed an alignment or something else. Whoever I spoke to on the phone told me I could bring it now, Once I got there, they told me it would need to be dropped off. At the time there was only three cars there, including me. Why does it matter whether I am present or not in regards to whether you can look at it or not and why didn’t the person over the phone Tell me they wouldn’t be able to look at it and It would need to be dropped off? This is the second time synergy has been the least accommodating. I liked it before it was synergy.

reviews.author: Heath
reviews.text: I have been here three times now. The staff works hard and really makes an effort get your car handled and get you back on the road. Two of those times I was actually met in the parking lot by a technician who asked what I needed done and put my vehicle in a service bay before I got inside the building. I observed another customer who came in shortly after 12 and asked the guy inside if she could get an oil change quickly enough to make it back to work before her lunch break ended. The guy went into the service area and said something to them and as I was leaving they were pulling her car into a bay. If I had to guess, she probably got back to work on time. The first time I brought a vehicle in they spent some time asking about what kind of oil I wanted and what each one would cost. After that I think they are going with what I selected the first time. I bring this up to say that at the places I have been to before, nobody asked. And frankly, I had to ask at other places if I wanted to know what they were using, so it was nice to be asked what oil I wanted in the vehicle.

reviews.author: Sarah Humphreys
reviews.text: I am new to the area from Ohio. I’m a huge supporter of local businesses. I found Synergy Auto Care from google. I spoke with Josh over email and he was very professional and polite. On the day of my appointment Josh greeted me and the guys did a great job with my vehicle. I will now be a regular customer at Synergy. I highly recommended coming here!

reviews.author: Matt Komara
reviews.text: We have a 2011 Subaru Forester with 258,000 miles on it. We brought it to Josh and his team Wednesday night for front end work. They went through our car completely and made the repairs needed in an extremely timely manner. They were able to even take care of an issue that came up after the repair. Any shop can fix a car. Only a professional shop like Synergy can make you feel comfortable with all that was done. Thanks again to the professional team at Synergy, in Wilson North Carolina

reviews.author: Patricia Taylor
reviews.text: Synergy absolutely saved me. My battery died. My husband has cancer and couldn't come to help me. I didn't know what I was gonna do. I saw their sign from where my dead car sat, so I called. Within 5 minutes, they were there, gave my battery a jump, and even offered to help me again if it happened again. They were personable and so nice!!!!!!!! I will definitely use their services again in the future.

reviews.author: charles barth
reviews.text: These guys are on it! Polite, fair with a sense of urgency, wich semes less common then it used to be. The place is clean and comfortable. I hesitate to write this review because I would like to keep it my little secret. I know someday soon there will be a much longer wait, but for now the service is quick and efficient. Old school customer service!

reviews.author: April Bland
reviews.text: Josh was great! He identified the problem with my blinker lights and took care of it quickly. He did what he promised and resolved the issue. Josh seems very honest. I would definitely use them again!

reviews.author: Joshua Peede
reviews.text: Josh and his team always go out of their way to give you the best service. Thank you for being an upstanding, honest company that is thorough, and knowledgeable. We are blessed to have you in Wilson!

reviews.author: Michael Poe
reviews.text: Clean & Inviting Atmosphere! The Staff here are very nice and knowledgeable. The Service was quick & efficient. They let you know what you need and don’t sugar coat anything or try and nickel and dime customers like some businesses. I recommend this local owned business to anyone.

reviews.author: Mark Brown
reviews.text: Took my vehicle to the dealership to get the oil changed and tires rotated. I go there because I have an oil change service contract. I always get the tires rotated when I get the oil changed. This time the dealership told me they couldn't rotate my tires because my lug nuts were swollen??? They normally rotate the tires with no problems. So I left and drove straight to Synergy. They immediately took my vehicle into a service bay and rotated my tires with no problems at all. Very professional and friendly staff. Glad they are close by. Thanks Synergy for a job well done.

reviews.author: Rhonda Washington
reviews.text: I love this business! Thier professionalism is top notch. The shop is clean and pleasantly scented. They take time to diagnose issues, explain the problem, and quickly get you in to correct the issue. Josh the owner is knowledgeable and fair. There are not too many places that do this quality of work.

reviews.author: Chad Bunn
reviews.text: 1st time here since this location became Synergy Auto. Great job, detailed but also quick service. I'll be back soon! UPDATED 3/2023.....Been several times now with multiple cars and these guys are GREAT each time!!

reviews.author: Ebelin Melgar
reviews.text: First time customer today and I was treated great! The team was very welcoming and did a wonderful job on my vehicle. The lobby is and looks super welcoming and their bay is so organized and clean! I was more than satisfied with the outcome! Thank you

reviews.author: Jennifer Smith
reviews.text: Took my car for a oil change and inspection and was greeted immediately upon arrival. Service was fast and efficient and employees were nice and explained services needed. Will definitely be using them again in the future!

reviews.author: Jasmine Nguyen
reviews.text: Had a nail in my tire and they patched it up for me free of cost! I was so thankful and still offered to pay but the man was insist on it! Highly recommend this place!!

reviews.author: Tracey Bass
reviews.text: Superb customer service. Josh and his staff are kind, courteous and knowledgeable. I appreciate their honesty and the education they provide each time I have my car serviced.

reviews.author: Susan Sullivan
reviews.text: This was my first visit. The techs are very friendly and knowledgeable. They inform you of options and prices before they work on your vehicle. I was very pleased with my experience here. Most definitely will be returning when my vehicle is in need of future service.

reviews.author: Bette Raper
reviews.text: This place is awesome!congrats on your 2 year anniversary. The team is great and they are very professional. You need to go and check them out. Really appreciate what they do for us. Good job guys!

reviews.author: Kimberly Youssef
reviews.text: I am very impressed with this business. It's clean, friendly, knowledgeable, & fairly priced. Got prompt personal attention. I have found my car care center. Hope other people from Wilson will give this new family owned business a try.

reviews.author: Peter Humphries
reviews.text: The first time there, They got me in pretty quick without an appointment. They did a great job. Will definitely go back.

reviews.author: Becky Stancill
reviews.text: This group of folks is the absolute best! From fast and efficient oil changes to searching and searching to find us the best and best priced tires. We wouldn’t go anywhere else!

reviews.author: Karen Janolis
reviews.text: Good service for a great price! Very knowledgeable and I didn't spend all day waiting. Very clean and comfortable waiting area. It's where we go for all of our car needs.

reviews.author: Alicia Appleton
reviews.text: Staff is always really friendly. Service is quick even when busy. I've never had issues with them trying to ask me to pay for services that aren't needed which is always a concern as a young woman.

reviews.author: Anthony McCallops
reviews.text: I found it interesting that they leave the keys in the cars after or even before servicing. I was picking my sisters white Honda up, and there was another white Honda there. I got into the wrong car, and could have driven away, but I realized it was not my sisters. Seems anybody could hop in one and take it for a spin.

reviews.author: Neal Pearson
reviews.text: Edit: After reading proprietor's response, I do have a plate light out. So I guess it was just a miscommunication; adjusting review to reflect that. To be clear - no one mentioned a plate light specifically, but stuff happens. Go see these guys. Always had good service here, but holding back the fifth star because the last time I was in for an oil change, the tech said I had a marker light out, and I did not. Probably an honest mistake, so not upset about it, but little things like that are not easily forgotten.

reviews.author: Michelle Carroll
reviews.text: My boyfriend and I have been using Synergy for majority of our vehicle maintenance needs lately and have been impressed. Fast friendly service and great prices that we compared.

reviews.author: OMEGA GAMING
reviews.text: I've been to synergy auto about 3 times so far. Everytime I feel at home and relaxed and confident that I will be well taken care of. No matter the problem big or small. It's the only shop I've ever been to where I feel at ease knowing I'm not being swindled or lied to. After a long night at work I bring my car in grab some coffee sit back and watch t.v.

reviews.author: Charnese Thompson
reviews.text: In response to so call owner. You never gave me a chance you kept over talking me. I know my question so don't talk like I didn't you was busy as you stated which let me believe you was rushing me off the phone so there you go. You could've stated that you was busy to call later time, instead you rush me , over talked me because you was busy . You could've handled it differently it was 2 questions. Please smh..I never had issues with you before this is why it's out of the norm, but I never said I want return because the service it's great.

reviews.author: Nate Goldsmith
reviews.text: Great experience with the team at Synergy. Quick, friendly, and knowledgeable. I won’t take my vehicles anywhere else.

reviews.author: Luther Brown
reviews.text: Synergy is a hassle free Auto Shop. So, my experience with this business was absolutely fantastic!!! Please, sew them for your mechanical needs.

reviews.author: Sarah Peede
reviews.text: I was very pleased with the professional staff here. The owner was very up-front about the repairs that needed to be made as well as what the price would be. I will definitely be using this business again.

reviews.author: todd and peyton Garliss
reviews.text: Each time I use this service everything is done quickly and efficiently. Best auto care I have EVER experienced! Love these guys.

reviews.author: Ace Ashworth
reviews.text: Great place! Clean shop, great service. Curb side greeting! Didn't get out of my vehicle until we had a great price for the service I needed! Highest recommendation!!!

reviews.author: C. Owens
reviews.text: They genuinely care about their work and customers. Careful to explain all the work performed. Even took photos as they worked to show their progress. Best experience I have ever had with an auto mechanic.

reviews.author: Tanya LP
reviews.text: Awesome experience. Very professional and friendly. Made me feel comfortable and provided information on what is needed for my car moving forward.

reviews.author: Lisa Abbott
reviews.text: Excellent and prompt service. Customer service was impeccable. Waiting area was very clean and inviting. Prices were great! Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Glenn Dew
reviews.text: Great service, low prices, and best of all, experienced mechanics that really care about helping their customers. I have tried all the car repair shops in Wilson, but these guys are the best!

reviews.author: Sarah Ellis
reviews.text: This place is amazing!!! Got me in same day for an emergency alignment! They’ve earned my business as a repeat customer!

reviews.author: Tim Bunn
reviews.text: Josh and the guys at Synergy are great. Josh really cares about his customers. I don't trust mechanics, but Josh is a great mechanic very honest. Thanks Josh

reviews.author: Chasity Autry
reviews.text: Went in for a state inspection and the Technicians were warm and welcoming. They got me in and out quickly . Will definitely be a repeat customer.

reviews.author: Charlene xo
reviews.text: Àwesome service.. Staff was very professional and friendly. Service was quick and efficient. Price for service rendered was compatible. I will use them again !

reviews.author: Ace Ashworth
reviews.text: Josh and his team are top knotch, and run a great clean shop. Always pays attention to details and makes sure my vehicles are running safe

reviews.author: David Allen
reviews.text: Friendly, courteous staff! Bright and clean waiting area! Very fast and very reasonable service! Love this place!

reviews.author: Amanda Alvarado
reviews.text: This place is the best! The customer service is top notch and the lobby is so clean. Very happy to keep coming here :)

reviews.author: Beverly Armstrong
reviews.text: They are so friendly everytime I come here, great service!, Don't think I will ever return to the big dealerships for service unless I absolutely have to.

reviews.author: Sara Preuss
reviews.text: Josh was super helpful. And the price was lower than quotes I'd gotten from other providers. Thanks so much!

reviews.author: Kevin Brown
reviews.text: Excellent quality work at a fair price. Honest, on time, and dependable. These guys really know what they're doing. Highly recommended

reviews.author: Angela Hayes
reviews.text: Professional staff, reasonably priced products, and quick service. Very acommodating and professional atmosphere. Would highly recommend this business.

reviews.author: Kendall Cota
reviews.text: Always thorough and efficient. Location is always clean and inviting and the staff, each of them, knowledgeable and friendly.

reviews.author: Anthony Barrick
reviews.text: Great service, they come and talk to you without pressuring you if they find anything while working on your vehicle.

reviews.author: Amanda Thompson
reviews.text: Every employee I talked to was friendly and helpful, the waiting area was clean, and the service was quick. I will definitely be back.

reviews.author: Josh Williams
reviews.text: Josh is the man!!! I can really appreciate a Family business and the place looks fantastic. Great service and great guy!

reviews.author: Dianne Boykin
reviews.text: Got and inspection and oil change was in and out in under 30 minutes let me know what will need to be replaced in the future so I can budget for it and how much it will cost I am a senior on a limited budget everyone was so friendly!

reviews.author: Boujee Baby Reviews
reviews.text: Best place in Wilson for oil changes and tune ups. They have a clean shop and excellent staffing and great pricing.

reviews.author: Vickie Keen
reviews.text: Will definitely be going back. Recommend them to all. Knowledgeable and very polite .Let's help them

reviews.author: Jason Gunnin
reviews.text: Awesome guys very knowledgeable ,friendly, and fair... definitely recommend bringing your vehicle here

reviews.author: Jeff B
reviews.text: The guys that work here are friendly and knowledgeable and very informative. Best of all, the place is clean, clean, clean, clean, clean!

reviews.author: Michelle Sheaffer
reviews.text: Amazing customer service!!! Trust worthy! They won't do the work if you dont need it. I was told I needed $1000 in struts, they looked and said they were fine, only needed spacers which was a serious price difference.
